marketing_wrapper: Medium. Each image is a solid vivid backdrop (blue, green, red, orange, indigo) with a white SF bold caption and an old iPhone 8-style home-button frame; the real screen is about 55% of each image. Status bars read 'Carrier' and show pre-notch devices, so the frames are dated (pre-iOS 26) relative to v2026.5.1. The per-image backdrop colours are wrapper only and do not appear in the UI.

typography.display: SF Pro bold large titles ('Meal Plan', 'Groceries'); recipe title in white bold SF over the photo
typography.numerals: SF proportional for quantities; timer '09:55' in bold SF orange (tabular-looking); rounded-feel numeric keypad digits
typography.weights: Bold large titles, regular body, semibold for highlighted quantities and tinted button labels

palette.accent_strategy: Semantic and functional: blue for ingredients, quantities and navigation; amber/orange for durations and timers; green for add/start; red for delete. Buttons use pale tinted fills with saturated tinted labels (blue on light blue, green on mint). Recipe photos supply the only other colour.
palette.source: palette.json 01-05 (#f1f3f2 / #f7f8f8 canvas, #ffffff cards); backdrop clusters #00a5ff, #00c16e, #ee3439, #fcb339, #4c59d7 are marketing; in-app blue/amber/green matched visually

shape.radius_language: large ~16pt cards and photo hero; pill tinted buttons ('Start', 'Scale', 'Ingredients', unit chips); circular icon buttons; ~8pt keypad keys
shape.borders_shadows: No borders; cards separated by background contrast; floating timer card and ingredient popover carry a soft shadow
shape.materials: flat, with a pre-26 translucent tab bar

density: medium: card-per-step list with comfortable padding; cook mode is low density with one step centred and lots of whitespace
layout: Recipe detail: photo hero card with title overlay, Start/basket/share action row, servings and prep chips, Ingredients card list. Steps: numbered cards with inline-coloured ingredients and durations. Cook mode: single step, prev/next circular arrows at the bottom, page dots. Meal Plan: day-grouped cards with thumbnail rows.
navigation: Native 4-tab bar: Plan, Recipes, Groceries, Settings (outline icons, blue selected). Native back chevron with text ('All Recipes', 'Meal Plan'), large titles, circular tinted '...' and timer buttons top-right. Custom quantity-entry sheet replaces the keyboard for groceries.
imagery_and_icons: Recipe photos (hero and thumbnails); SF Symbols outline icons in tabs and buttons
signature_visual_move: Recipe text is a live interface: ingredients highlight in blue and durations in amber, and tapping a duration spawns a floating step timer.
tells_present: Cards everywhere (every step and meal in its own white card)

direction_fit.secondary: Fluid Continuity (weak, inferred from popovers and timer)
direction_fit.why: Cook mode shows one step at a time with large text and big prev/next targets, the countertop variant of Glance Board; colour is strictly semantic (ingredient vs time). Visually it is close to stock iOS, so the direction lives in behaviour more than in style.

notes: Confirms the text record's 'plain visuals, wins on interaction'. Screens are old marketing frames; current 2026 UI (likely Liquid Glass) is not shown. The pastel colour-coded custom keypad (fractions lavender, digits mint, operators amber, delete pink) is the most distinctive visual element.
